summary: PR B of #309 (personality-wave-26 + follower-wave-15), stacked on PR A (#324). Shared lane: the rules-side engine changes in src/L5R.Core/*.cs are the substance, but publishing also adds the two cards' shipped runtime art (src/L5R.Client/Content/Published/*.jpg) and regenerates docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx -- no UI logic changed. Wires Daidoji Ebizo (oracle-l5r-1629, scan-verified from the Promotional-Emperor printing 2) and Master Scouts (oracle-l5r-4867, scan-verified; literally the same trait, no new engine code). Adds ActionCarriesKeyword (an action carries a keyword when its ability prints it via AbilityDefinition.ActionKeywords, or its card has it -- an ability inherits its card's keywords) as the general Recon/Ninja/Kiho/... classification, and the AfterOwnActionTraits registry + FireAfterOwnActionTraits: 'after the resolution of your [keyword] action: Give this card +nF' as a TRAIT (mandatory, repeatable, usable while bowed, in force wherever the card is in play, only for its controller's own actions), fired from the ExecuteAbilityEffects tail and from ResolveAttack/ResolveDuel for the two actions that resolve later. Ebizo's Effect force-after-own-recon-action -> (Recon, Force, +1) applied with ApplyModifier: until end of turn, per the core-rules Duration default and Apprentice Shinobi's identical 'Give this card +1F' precedent (flagged prominently: the permanent reading is a one-line change). ebizo-attack: Ranged Attack, strength = his live Force at declaration. A Recon Reaction counts as a Recon action (Yuki's does and triggers Ebizo). No already-wired ability prints a Recon prefix (whole published text and catalogue searched); Yuki (PR A) is the only tagged real ability; training fixtures cover tag vs inherited keyword. Other cards sharing the trigger reported (Daidoji Akeha, Narizane, Advanced Intelligence, Beyond the Line, Hidden Falls Dojo). BLOCKERS entries removed for 1629 and 4867; decision doc docs/decisions/2026-09-18-recon-action-tag-and-daidoji-ebizo.md.
validation: dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Core.Tests: core 200/200, published 57/57, gold-parity 18/18, gold-quote 20/20, battle-timing 21/21, recon-action 11/11 (new), deck-format 9/9, deck-workshop 10/10; bash tools/check.sh --skip-client all green (Python 43 + 130, L5R.AI.Tests 14/14, L5R.Server.Tests 6/6, L5R.Client.Transport.Tests 5/5). Mutation checks each made the intended test fail (trait for either player, only on a battlefield, ignoring the inherited keyword, no fire after a deferred Attack, no fire after a duel, constant attack strength, bonus amount). Pinned published count recomputed 391 -> 393 (Ebizo + Master Scouts) from the actual files, counted independently from content/published/*.json.
remaining: Recompute the pinned published count again when this rebases onto main after #324 (and Kahoku #316 if it lands first). Open: the +1F duration (until end of turn implemented), inherited-keyword check for a deferred Attack uses the performer's keywords.
